summary: Return own enumerable string keys in ECMAScript enumeration order.

semantics.order: integer indices ascending then other strings in creation order

caveats: Object.keys does not invoke ordinary property getters, but Proxy traps can run.
C# reflection order is not a semantic substitute.

tests.name: nonenumerable and symbols omitted
tests.input: const s=Symbol(); const x={[s]:1}; Object.defineProperty(x,'a',{value:1}); console.log(Object.keys(x).length);
